attribution: Drafted with AI; the gallery text is unsigned on the site
method: Every New Nifty on the Block work was viewed on dated contact sheets and given a short visual note. The collection is split into three parts at dates where the drawing changes; inside each part, galleries were formed from the images alone, without the earlier labels or galleries, then each gallery was rendered as one wall and checked. Works are listed in recorded order. Dates are US Central.

parts.description: Whole figures, creatures and black silhouettes, ending with the May 2022 light beams and the first framed masks.
